steps: (a): 5 + ? = 15. Since 5 + 10 = 15, the missing number is 10, so 15 − 5 = 10.
(b): 10 + ? = 100. Since 10 + 90 = 100, the missing number is 90, so 100 − 10 = 90.
(c): 34 + ? = 74. Since 34 + 40 = 74, the missing number is 40, so 74 − 34 = 40.

(a): (+1) − (+4) = ___; (b): (0) − (+2) = ___; (c): (+4) − (+1) = ___; (d): (0) − (−2) = ___; (e): (+4) − (−3) = ___; (f): (−4) − (−3) = ___; (g): (−1) − (+2) = ___; (h): (−2) − (−2) = ___; (i): (−1) − (+1) = ___; (j): (+3) − (−3) = ___
steps_tex: Movement needed $=$ Target Floor $-$ Starting Floor. The first number is the target and the second is the start.
$(a)$: From Floor $+4$ down to Floor $+1$ is $3$ floors down, so $(+1) - (+4) = -3$.
$(b)$: From Floor $+2$ down to Floor $0$ is $2$ floors down, so $0 - (+2) = -2$.
$(c)$: From Floor $+1$ up to Floor $+4$ is $3$ floors up, so $(+4) - (+1) = +3$.
$(d)$: From Floor $-2$ up to Floor $0$ is $2$ floors up, so $0 - (-2) = +2$.
$(e)$: From Floor $-3$ up to Floor $+4$ is $3 + 4 = 7$ floors up, so $(+4) - (-3) = +7$.
$(f)$: From Floor $-3$ down to Floor $-4$ is $1$ floor down, so $(-4) - (-3) = -1$.
$(g)$: From Floor $+2$ down to Floor $-1$ is $2 + 1 = 3$ floors down, so $(-1) - (+2) = -3$.
$(h)$: From Floor $-2$ to Floor $-2$ there is no movement, so $(-2) - (-2) = 0$.
(i): From Floor $+1$ down to Floor $-1$ is $1 + 1 = 2$ floors down, so $(-1) - (+1) = -2$.
$(j)$: From Floor $-3$ up to Floor $+3$ is $3 + 3 = 6$ floors up, so $(+3) - (-3) = +6$.
steps: Movement needed = Target Floor − Starting Floor. The first number is the target and the second is the start.
(a): From Floor +4 down to Floor +1 is 3 floors down, so (+1) − (+4) = −3.
(b): From Floor +2 down to Floor 0 is 2 floors down, so 0 − (+2) = −2.
(c): From Floor +1 up to Floor +4 is 3 floors up, so (+4) − (+1) = +3.
(d): From Floor −2 up to Floor 0 is 2 floors up, so 0 − (−2) = +2.
(e): From Floor −3 up to Floor +4 is 3 + 4 = 7 floors up, so (+4) − (−3) = +7.
(f): From Floor −3 down to Floor −4 is 1 floor down, so (−4) − (−3) = −1.
(g): From Floor +2 down to Floor −1 is 2 + 1 = 3 floors down, so (−1) − (+2) = −3.
(h): From Floor −2 to Floor −2 there is no movement, so (−2) − (−2) = 0.
(i): From Floor +1 down to Floor −1 is 1 + 1 = 2 floors down, so (−1) − (+1) = −2.
(j): From Floor −3 up to Floor +3 is 3 + 3 = 6 floors up, so (+3) − (−3) = +6.
item.text:

$2$. $(a)$: From Floor $+4$ down to Floor $+1$ is $3$ floors down, so $(+1) - (+4) = -3$.
$3$. $(b)$: From Floor $+2$ down to Floor $0$ is $2$ floors down, so $0 - (+2) = -2$.
$4$. $(c)$: From Floor $+1$ up to Floor $+4$ is $3$ floors up, so $(+4) - (+1) = +3$.
$5$. $(d)$: From Floor $-2$ up to Floor $0$ is $2$ floors up, so $0 - (-2) = +2$.
$6$. $(e)$: From Floor $-3$ up to Floor $+4$ is $3 + 4 = 7$ floors up, so $(+4) - (-3) = +7$.
$7$. $(f)$: From Floor $-3$ down to Floor $-4$ is $1$ floor down, so $(-4) - (-3) = -1$.
$8$. $(g)$: From Floor $+2$ down to Floor $-1$ is $2 + 1 = 3$ floors down, so $(-1) - (+2) = -3$.
$9$. $(h)$: From Floor $-2$ to Floor $-2$ there is no movement, so $(-2) - (-2) = 0$.
$10$. (i): From Floor $+1$ down to Floor $-1$ is $1 + 1 = 2$ floors down, so $(-1) - (+1) = -2$.
$11$. $(j)$: From Floor $-3$ up to Floor $+3$ is $3 + 3 = 6$ floors up, so $(+3) - (-3) = +6$.
Answer: $(a)$: $-3$; $(b)$: $-2$; $(c)$: $+3$; $(d)$: $+2$; $(e)$: $+7$; $(f)$: $-1$; $(g)$: $-3$; $(h)$: $0$; (i): $-2$; $(j)$: $+6$
